**Analysis:**
- Test image: Soybean pod split open, revealing a seed completely enveloped in **white fluffy cottony mycelial growth**. Pod interior walls are also lined with white mold. Pod exterior shows darkening.
- This precisely matches **White_Mold** (Sclerotinia sclerotiorum): "pods contain smaller, lighter, cottony seeds" and "white fluffy mycelial growth on stems especially at nodes"
- The White_Mold reference collage (top-left panel) shows virtually identical cottony white growth inside/around pods
- No other disease in this list produces fluffy white cottony mold inside pods — Downy Mildew shows crusty dried mass and leaf symptoms; Phomopsis shows dark pycnidia spots; Anthracnose shows black acervuli
